developer.connect_contract.description: The ONE Developer Connect contract for developer/AI/tool requesters: how to ask for a capability, who authorises it, where credentials live, how execution happens and where evidence lands. Declares no new authority — every path in the flow already exists and stays the owner of its own decision.
developer.connect_contract.description_th: สัญญากลางของ Developer Connect — AI/เครื่องมือขอ capability ผ่านเส้นนี้ ไม่มีใครอ่าน secret เอง และไม่มีเส้นอนุมัติซ้ำ
developer.connect_contract.implementation: registry/mcp-resource-registry.json (declaration only) + the existing endpoints listed in flow
developer.connect_contract.note: Declared 2026-09-23 (Developer Connect directive). status stays 'planned' until the live Owner-authorised proof is run — an Owner approval may never be simulated, so this entry is not marked integration_tested yet.

flow.requester: AI / Cline / Codex / MCP client / developer tool — requester and worker only, never an authority
flow.1_capability_request: POST /api/admin/connectors/providers/[providerId]/approval-request — records a REAL proposal on the existing Integration Gateway Propose Channel (idempotent; answers approval_not_required when the contract says so)
flow.2_owner_decision: POST /api/gateway/proposals/[id]/decide { decision: approved | rejected } — the ONLY path that turns a proposal into a run, reusing runAutomationCommand()'s whitelist
flow.3_owner_evidence: engines/jobs/approval-evidence.ts#resolveApprovalEvidence — READ-ONLY index over owner_auth_audit_log (passkey/biometric), pending_authorizations, integration_gateway_proposals, destructive_action_log, audit_logs; it can BLOCK a job, never approve one
flow.4_credential_authority: Supabase Vault via the SECURITY DEFINER RPCs in services/ai-connection/vault.ts (the vault schema is not exposed to PostgREST) + the connector Run gate core/connector-loader.ts#requireConnector (connect → register → test → enable → run, enforced by scripts/check-connector-lifecycle.sh)
flow.5_authorized_executor: engines/integration-gateway/automationCommands.ts#runAutomationCommand — single whitelisted execution path, on top of the canonical writers
flow.6_providers: Supabase / GitHub / Railway / LINE / other providers reached through their Connect adapters — never by a tool holding a raw secret
flow.7_evidence: integration_gateway_events + integration_gateway_proposals + audit_logs (+ dev_loop_evidence_events for developer-loop work)

capabilities.policy: Scopes are separate capabilities; holding one NEVER implies the next. database.verify does not permit database.write; database.write does not permit database.migration.apply; a Supabase credential never permits deploy.production. Each capability is requested and decided on its own.

database.read.credential: none beyond the requester's own session

database.verify.credential: supabase_service_role (opened by the credential authority, never handed to the requester)

credential_boundary_decision.rule: The application runtime (services/**) keeps its SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment bootstrap; canonical writers and supabaseAdmin() are NOT rerouted in this work. Every developer tool / AI / Cline / Codex / MCP surface must NOT read the service-role (or any credential) from the environment — it resolves credentials through this contract (Credential Authority + Owner Authorization) only. Enforced by scripts/developer-connect-contract.test.ts (D5/D5b/D5d/D5e).
credential_boundary_decision.closed_bypass: app/api/admin/ide/_lib/edgeFunctionWorkerRuntime.ts used to read SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and arbitrary named env vars directly; it now resolves every auth header through core/connector-loader.ts#requireConnector and fails closed without one.
credential_boundary_decision.separate_later_work: Moving the whole application runtime (supabaseAdmin() and every canonical writer) into the Credential Authority is deliberately NOT part of this work.

forbidden_by_contract: a requester reading a credential value itself (no env/secret access from AI or developer tools)
a permanent service-role/API key/token held by any AI
a second approval store, a second decide route, or a second credential vault
using database.verify approval to apply a migration or to deploy
simulating an Owner decision (biometric/passkey) from inside the system
